params.name: circular
params.type: { authorTicketNo?: string | null; uploadedAt?: any } | null

doc: WHO MAY CHANGE A CIRCULAR (PATCH and DELETE): the HOD of C&IT may change any; a delegate of the Circular manager only the circulars he or she uploaded, within EDIT_DELETE_WINDOW_HOURS of the upload. I decide this from the DATABASE on every request, and decide it again under the facility lock inside the transaction. The old rule was "the ticket starts with 4 and is the author": no login-state check beyond the cookie, no audit row, a withdrawn delegate could keep deleting, and a non-executive delegate could never delete his own upload.
